name: pg_psql_psql_expanded_aligned
subject: psql: Fix expanded aligned output
goal:
psql's expanded output draws a malformed or inconsistently sized right border in aligned and wrapped formats when all column names and values are short.

With border 2 and expanded mode enabled, select two integer columns from a two-row table under both `\pset format aligned` and `wrapped`. Every record must use the same field width, the values must line up, and the closing border must span that width exactly. Non-expanded output, other border settings and rows that already require a wider field must retain their formatting.
